release_notes:
Minor Feature Release - Connection & Import Enhancements.

New Features:
  - Auto-Reconnect: Retries lost serial connections with exponential backoff (1s to 16s).
  - Custom Import Schema: Custom sheet names, elapsed time column mapping, and microsecond/unit scaling for log imports.
  - Memory Cap Settings: Custom limit on historical samples stored in the live plotter to control memory footprint.
  - Saturation Warning Badge: Status bar badge indicating queue saturation or packet drops (dismissible via click).
  - Title Bar Accent Matching: Dynamically styles native title bars to match active Windows/theme accent colors.
